title: CAR INSURANCE
subject: listening

paragraphs.text: MAN: Oh hello ...I'd like to ask about insurance for my car：
WOMAN: Yes, of course. I'll just take a few details. What's your name?
WOMAN: 27 Bank Road. Is that in Greendale?
WOMAN: And what's your daytime phone number?
WOMAN: And could I ask what your occupation is?
WOMAN: OK… now a few details about your car... What size is the engine? It's 1200 ccs.
WOMAN: Thank you ... and the make and model?
WOMAN: Could you spell the model name please?
WOMAN: Ah yes...thanks. And when was it made?
WOMAN: Lovely...right...1 presume you've had a previous insurer?
WOMAN: Right...we need to know the name of the company.
WOMAN: Thank you, and have you made any insurance claims in the last five years?
WOMAN: And what was the problem?
WOMAN: That's fine, Mr. Jones... that's all we need to know at the moment...
WOMAN: And will there be any other named drivers?
WOMAN: Could you spell the surname please?
WOMAN: OK thank you ... And what relationship is he to you?
WOMAN: And what will you or Mr Payntcr be using the car for?
WOMAN: Social use (murmuring). Will you be using it to travel to work?
WOMAN: And finally ... when would you like to start the insurance?
MAN: HI need it from the 31st of January.
WOMAN: Right -Mr Jones ... I'm getting a couple of quotes coming up on the computer now…and the best bet looks like being with a company called Red Flag.
WOMAN: And that comes out at $450 per year...
MAN: Well…that seems OK ... it's quite a bit lower than I've been paying up to now …
WOMAN: Great... so would you like me to go ahead with that?
WOMAN: How would you like to pay?
MAN：哦你好…我想问一下我的汽车保险：
WOMAN：好的，当然。我只需要问几个细节。你叫什么名字？
WOMAN：你白天的电话号码是多少？
WOMAN：我可以问你的职业是什么吗？
WOMAN：好的。…现在需要问几个关于你的车的细节…发动机的尺寸是多少？
WOMAN：谢谢…是什么厂家和型号？
WOMAN：能拼写一下型号的名字吗？
WOMAN：啊，好的，谢谢。这是什么时候生产的？
WOMAN：好的…我猜想你过去参加过保险？
WOMAN：好…我们需要知道公司的名称。
WOMAN：谢谢你，在过去的五年里你有保险理赔过吗？
WOMAN：好的，琼斯先生…．这是我们现在需要知道的一切…
WOMAN：还需要其他被指名的司机吗？
WOMAN：你能拼写一下这个姓吗？
WOMAN：好的，谢谢你…他和你有什么关系？
WOMAN：你或Paynter先生需要使用汽车做什么用途？
WOMAN：社交使用(低语)。你会用它来上班还和旅行吗？
WOMAN：最后…你想什么时候开始保险？
WOMAN：好的，琼斯先生…我现在在电脑上拿到了一些报价，最好的选择看起来像是与一家名为红色标志的公司。
MAN：嗯……看起来可以…这比我现在要付的要低一点…
WOMAN：好的…所以你想让我继续吗？

Questions 1-10

Complete the form below.

Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER in each gap.

questions.explanation:
1．地址需首字母大写，并注意拼写。27 Bank Road。考试中若出现有难度的拼写一定会给出。

2．原文直接回答what’s your occupation这个问题。而不理解occupation为何意的考生就需要预测发音，在原文中努力对应dentist。

3．直接给出了拼写，全大写字母更为安全。只有首字母大写不扣分。

4．同第1题的原则，对于未给出拼写的词，可以把脑海中浮现的最简单词汇认作那个词。

5．原文给出了1999，说明答案即将出现。it was stolen对应题干结构，无难度。

6．同第3题的原则。

7．relationship在题于利原文中未变化，brother-in-law可能出现拼写错误。

8．social use给出后意味着答案的来临。在to travel to work这个短语中选择用travel to work填空就能满足题目的字数限制。

9．同第1、4两题的原则

transcriptHtml:
Section 1

WOMAN: Hello ...motor insurance department..
MAN: Oh hello ...I'd like to ask about insurance for my car：
WOMAN: Yes, of course. I'll just take a few details. What's your name?
MAN: Patrick Jones.
WOMAN: And your address?
MAN: It's 27 Bank Road.
WOMAN: 27 Bank Road. Is that in Greendale?
MAN: Yes.
WOMAN: And what's your daytime phone number?
MAN: My work number is 730453.
WOMAN: And could I ask what your occupation is?
MAN: Dentist.
WOMAN: OK… now a few details about your car... What size is the engine? It's 1200 ccs.
WOMAN: Thank you ... and the make and model?
MAN: It's a Hewton Sable.
WOMAN: Could you spell the model name please?
MAN: Yes...S-A-B-L-E.
WOMAN: Ah yes...thanks. And when was it made?
MAN: 1997.
WOMAN: Lovely...right...1 presume you've had a previous insurer?
MAN: Yes.
WOMAN: Right...we need to know the name of the company.
MAN: Yes...it was Northern Star.
WOMAN: Thank you, and have you made any insurance claims in the last five years?
MAN: Yes...one in 1999.
WOMAN: And what was the problem?
MAN: It was stolen ...but...
WOMAN: That's fine, Mr. Jones... that's all we need to know at the moment...


WOMAN: And will there be any other named drivers?
MAN: Just the one...
WOMAN: And his name?
MAN: Simon Payntcr.
WOMAN: Could you spell the surname please?
MAN: P-A-Y-N-T-E-R.
WOMAN: OK thank you ... And what relationship is he to you?
MAN: He's my brother-in-law.
WOMAN: And what will you or Mr Payntcr be using the car for?
MAN: Well...mainly for social use...
WOMAN: Social use (murmuring). Will you be using it to travel to work?
MAN: Yes... sometimes.
WOMAN: ...Anything else?
MAN: No. That's it...
WOMAN: And finally ... when would you like to start the insurance?
MAN: HI need it from the 31st of January.
WOMAN: Right -Mr Jones ... I'm getting a couple of quotes coming up on the computer now…and the best bet looks like being with a company called Red Flag.
MAN: Yeah.
WOMAN: And that comes out at $450 per year...
MAN: Well…that seems OK ... it's quite a bit lower than I've been paying up to now …
WOMAN: Great... so would you like me to go ahead with that?
MAN: Sure …why not?
WOMAN: How would you like to pay?

 

WOMAN：你好…汽车保险部…

MAN：哦你好…我想问一下我的汽车保险：

WOMAN：好的，当然。我只需要问几个细节。你叫什么名字？

MAN：琼斯帕特里克。

WOMAN：你的地址？

MAN：是27号银行路.

WOMAN： 27号银行路。是在Greendale吗？

MAN：是的。

WOMAN：你白天的电话号码是多少？

MAN：我的工作号码是730453。

WOMAN：我可以问你的职业是什么吗？

MAN：牙医。

WOMAN：好的。…现在需要问几个关于你的车的细节…发动机的尺寸是多少？

MAN：是1200ccs。

WOMAN：谢谢…是什么厂家和型号？

MAN：是Hewton Sable。

WOMAN：能拼写一下型号的名字吗？

MAN：是的…S-a-b-l-e。

WOMAN：啊，好的，谢谢。这是什么时候生产的？

MAN：1997。

WOMAN：好的…我猜想你过去参加过保险？

MAN：是的。

WOMAN：好…我们需要知道公司的名称。

MAN：好的…是北方之星。

WOMAN：谢谢你，在过去的五年里你有保险理赔过吗？
